_doc: The lair bosses' attacks (scripts/match/boss.gd; BossMoves reads this; --boss-tell-check asserts it). tell_s: the wind-up in seconds, from the first ground ring to the hit. quickens: the tell shortens with enrage and phase (enrage_tell_k, phase_tell_k), never below min_tell_s. shape: circle (radius_m, centred on the boss or the aimed spot), line (length_m x width_m), ring (an expanding ground wave: speed_mps out to reach_m) or shots (rays of width_m; projectile hits, not ground hits). dmg: raw damage at tier 1, before the tier, enrage and phase multipliers; dash_escape false means the move is not meant to be dashed late (rolling waves are jumped or dashed through). Parity note: the source boss and camp data is not in briefs/supervive-data (kits, physics and layout only), so tells here are our own: they were not shortened, and the compounding wind-up bug (every slam got shorter) is fixed in code.
